items.title: AVGN Vol. 6 DVD
items.description: This is an archive of the 2012 Screwattack AVGN Vol. 6 DVD. It has all the episodes from Episode 98 (Day Dreaming Davey) to Episode 107 (Schwarzenegger Games) and bonus features, although the episodes do not have the copyrighted material that they did on Screwattack/Gametrailers and YouTube.
